entries.title: Psalms 136:1
segments: ¶Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for [He is] good! For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:2
segments: Oh, give thanks to the God of gods! For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:3
segments: Oh, give thanks to the Lord of lords! For His mercy [endures] forever:

entries.title: Psalms 136:4
segments: To Him who alone does great wonders, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:5
segments: To Him who by wisdom made the heavens, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:6
segments: To Him who laid out the earth above the waters, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:7
segments: To Him who made great lights, For His mercy [endures] forever-

entries.title: Psalms 136:8
segments: The sun to rule by day, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:9
segments: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:10
segments: ¶To Him who struck Egypt in their firstborn, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:11
segments: And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:12
segments: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:13
segments: To Him who divided the Red Sea in two, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:14
segments: And made Israel pass through the midst of it, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:15
segments: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:16
segments: To Him who led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:17
segments: To Him who struck down great kings, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:18
segments: And slew famous kings, For His mercy [endures] forever-

entries.title: Psalms 136:19
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:20
segments: And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy [endures] forever-

entries.title: Psalms 136:21
segments: And gave their land as a heritage, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:22
segments: A heritage to Israel His servant, For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:23
segments: ¶Who remembered us in our lowly state, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:24
segments: And rescued us from our enemies, For His mercy [endures] forever;

entries.title: Psalms 136:25
segments: Who gives food to all flesh, For His mercy [endures] forever.

entries.title: Psalms 136:26
segments: Oh, give thanks to the God of heaven! For His mercy [endures] forever.
